title: MQTT topics, QoS, and retained messages

spans.text: Goal: apply “MQTT topics, QoS, and retained messages” to a real program or device. The key principle is: QoS controls delivery guarantees and retransmission behavior. In a project, follow this guidance: Separate command topics from telemetry and restrict who may publish commands.
QUESTION: What will this example do? Predict the result first.
Publishes telemetry/site-7/device-2/temperature and listens on commands/site-7/device-2; broker messages depend on connected clients.
MQTT clients publish and subscribe by topic. QoS 0/1/2 changes delivery behavior; retained messages store the latest value per topic. Topic design affects privacy and scale.

Key line: `mosquitto_sub -h broker.example.test -t "telemetry/site-7/+"`
What it does: QoS controls delivery guarantees and retransmission behavior.
Why it is used: Separate command topics from telemetry and restrict who may publish commands.
If omitted or changed: Do not put personal data in topic names or public brokers; use broker ACLs and secure transport.
